photo.title: Photo
photo.meta: Shown beside your name across the dashboard.
photo.hint: JPG or PNG, up to 5 MB.

personal.title: Personal Information
personal.meta: Your own details — you don't need a super admin to change these.
personal.email_note: Your email is your sign-in name and cannot be changed here — ask a super admin if it needs to move.

password.meta: Changing it signs your other devices out.
password.super_admin_note: The super admin password is set in the server configuration and can't be changed from the dashboard.
password.hint: At least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

toast.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices will need to sign in again.
toast.image_too_large: Image must be 5 MB or smaller.
